title: CLR/111/2014 of Dharmendra Kaushik Vs Smt Shashi Bhatt AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
CLR 111/2014
Honíble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Having heard Mr. Narendra
Bali, Advocate, for the revisionist on
the admissibility, it transpires that
the plaintiff is the son, while
defendant no. 2 is the mother.
Mother sold her property to
defendant no. 1 after the death of
her husband. Son has challenged
the sale of such property by his
mother on the premise that the such
property was purchased by his
father from the joint income of his
family and there was no
independent income of Smt.
Shakuntala Devi to purchase this
property.
Be that as it may, the fact
remains that the plaintiff
Dharmendra Kaushik has sought
the cancellation of such sale deed
under the guise of declaration of it
being void. So, the relief calls for the
payment of ad valorem Court Fee as
held out by the Court below.
This revision is bereft of any
merit and is dismissed at the very
threshold.
